steps.content: You win and banish the contamination. No one dies. But it doesn't bring any sense of security at all.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Waaah!

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Daddy, Mommy... Where are you? Come back please... Waaah!
The child's cries worsen the crowd's anxiety. Many of them are staring at you.
Meanwhile, amid the people's frightened murmurs, you hear a strange voice.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: It's him... It's him... DisCity's lapdog... A spy sent by the Executive Committee... That snake...
steps.female_content: It's her... It's her... DisCity's lapdog... A spy sent by the Executive Committee... That snake...

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Of course this place is dangerous. He brought the contamination. He's... still pretending...
steps.female_content: Of course this place is dangerous. She brought the contamination. She's... still pretending...

steps.content: No response. But the crowd seems influenced by it. Your anger only intensifies their panic.
Rustfire members arrive hastily and want to take over the evacuation work, but even they get dragged into the whirlpool of suspicion.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Rustfire is no different, colluding with that one. They were the ones who let the armor in. Many people saw it.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: They want to kick us out of the Drifter Camp, want to spare us nothing... I won't accept this!

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: The Drifter Camp is our home, isn't it? No other places will accept us. We can't let them have their way!

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: ...Kill him!
A pair of hands suddenly clutches your neck from behind. You look back to find a familiar face.

steps.speaker: Armed Rustfire Personnel
steps.content: Tally, what are you doing?

steps.speaker: (Transition)
steps.content: Tally's portrait

<size=32>The barbecue stand owner, who once smiled humbly and served you bean curd, is strangling you from behind. His face is filled with terror as if shocked by his own action. Those arms are not restraining you strenuously, but he doesn't dare relax them either.</size>
You stop the Sinners from flipping out and attempt to talk to the man behind you.

steps.speaker: Options
steps.content: Do you believe what they say?
options: Do you believe what they say?

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: I... I... don't know...

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: You lied to us... You're not an Outland bigwig or a Syndican... You're just an intruder. You have that thing, that Mania power, but you're still pretending...

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: You could even take apart that iron monster. If you use your power on us... You...

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Right... The Legion is no more. Zoya is no more. No one can protect us. No one can lead us...

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: It was also because of you, that Zoya was... It was you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're going to listen to hearsay, why don't you listen to me? And Julien, Dudu, and K.K. Out of all these people, why do you choose to listen to the most unsettling voice?

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: I don't know... but I really don't want to go!

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: My skewers are dry and meatless. I know they're not good. Those thugs mucked up my stand many times before.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: But the people here like them. They find them tasty. Even if I don't make as much money here, I don't want to leave...
He seems dazed. If it's not due to Mania, someone must have incited him to make him so on edge, close to having a mental breakdown.

steps.speaker: Options
options: As long as you survive, you'll find another home.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: You won't survive! The homeless can't survive if they get separated! That's what they want!

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Then what do you want me to do?!
You're about to answer him when you look up and see the truss bridge collapse suddenly.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Use your power anyway. You must save him
The shackles are dangerous. Drag him away

steps.content: You forget about the danger of the shackles instantly and raise your hand...
Your power knocks off the steel truss. It smashes down next to your feet, then rolls underground. Tally freezes for a second before he starts crying loudly.
You feel something surge into your mouth and immediately vomit.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Haha... You're a monster... Winning people over with such deadly power. You're so good at this, so good... You've deceived yet another victim...

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Who's next... When will you act again... You want them all dead anyway...
Something seeps out of the top of your head. You catch that voice. In the crowd, you see an inconspicuous man, that single-eyed curse glinting on his face.
It's too late to alert him, so you drag yourself forward despite still being trapped by those arms, but the strong man won't budge. Suddenly, the force restraining you is gone and someone shoves you.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Ah...
The man who pushes you away looks dazed. Like a reflex, he stares at you blankly, his eyes full of confusion. The next moment...
The huge truss bridge hits the strong man's head. The joints of his entire body throb and give out, and he tumbles down like a pile of cotton. Within a split second, he vanishes.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Hehehe... Hahaha... Look, look! This is what they want. We'll all die for nothing!
Something seeps out of the top of your head. You catch that voice. In the crowd, you see an inconspicuous man, that single-eyed curse glinting on his face.
